new_items.title: Compare client mastering peaks at Wayland integer wire precision
new_items.notes: Avoid double mapping from rounded client declarations while preserving exact native declarations and mapping curve. Native /color-hdr/mapping/wire-peak control distinguishes 880/881/882; fixture display 616 at reference 142, client reference 203. Existing target-volume implementation is a prerequisite. Extract/rebase onto agreed current upstream design; no new standalone submission port is prepared.

new_items.title: Write shared-memory screen captures in the negotiated pixel format
new_items.notes: Monitor, area and virtual paths had hard-coded ARGB readback despite negotiated ten-bit/float layouts. Digital controls cover XR30/XB30/half-float/BGRx and same-stream format changes; XR30/XB30 agree exactly and half-float differs at most0.574 ten-bit code. MemFd evidence, not DMA-BUF or optical qualification. Upstream extraction/current base and focused native regression still required.

new_items.title: Own synthetic tiling animations without consuming native Shell completion accounting
new_items.notes: Six patches on actual upstream v56. Keep ownership, cancellation, overlays, finite geometry and Shell callback ease correction together. Historical first-five source has35 distinct valid offline passes from26 initial+9 failed-only retries, not a new full clean35 run. Sixth callback-API patch has source/package proof; no invented fresh full-suite or broad fullscreen/cross-mode acceptance. Current upstream port, candidate commit explanatory bodies/attribution and latest six-patch focused qualification remain before submission.

new_items.title: Expose immutable per-surface preferred display targets with lifecycle invalidation
new_items.notes: Existing shared Wayland color manager owns feedback; default target discovery remains separate from experimental content rendering. Copies physical primaries/black/peak/reference and rejects invalid generations. Native startup, late-manager and reentrant destruction controls passed on pinned Ubuntu source. Agree GTK public API, per-output move/spanning/hotplug coverage and current upstream port. Split unrelated coordinate fix GTK-2 out of the combined source patch.

new_items.title: Store green, blue and white Y coordinates in their own Wayland fields
new_items.notes: Three listener paths (explicit primaries, named primaries, target primaries) overwrote red Y instead of setting g_y/b_y/w_y. It is embedded in GTK-1 patch, but independently upstreamable. Extract minimal baseline correction and focused listener regression, verify current upstream still affected; existing combined compilation/replay is not that standalone proof.

new_items.title: Track a per-surface HDR rendering lease and actual presentation precision
new_items.notes: Demand-scoped HDR lease invalidates target/draw-context/precision witnesses and returns to SDR when released. Native EGL four-patch PQ samples, normal Vulkan/introspection and lease lifecycle have scoped evidence. Public API and renderer/offload semantics require maintainer discussion; package symbol/changelog patches are distribution delivery only.

new_items.title: Query implementation read format/type using GLES-supported framebuffer state
new_items.notes: A one-pixel normalized16-bit PQ source reproduced transparent black under the normal Vulkan GTK consumer when NVIDIA rejected EGL export. glGetFramebufferParameteriv generated GL_INVALID_ENUM; glGetIntegerv recovered the exact four stored16-bit words. Correction also gates desktop GL at4.5. Extract/rebase minimal generic fix and add upstream regression; combined package/player controls do not substitute for standalone current-upstream proof.

new_items.title: Bind original video pictures and asynchronous target regrading to each GtkVideo view
new_items.notes: Each realized view has copied target, lease and mapper; original pictures retained before playsink and stale stream/caps/view/target generations rejected. Default Vulkan two-view paused616→308→616 exact-return, source replacement, one-view destruction and absent/incompatible/incomplete SDK SDR startup pass. Agree generic upstream mapper/destination integration rather than sending the private provider or distribution SDK coupling. No private mapper equations or implementation belong in submission.

new_items.title: Preserve ICC gamut and precision in floating-point textures, with alpha and stride correctness
new_items.notes: Actual code belongs to Glycin3.1 embedded in Loupe50, not a Loupe application patch. Convert ICC into linear BT.2020 float16/32 instead of clipping/quantizing into source integer sRGB; preserve CICP precedence, invalid-profile fallback, alpha, source row stride and transactional failure. Alpha correction folds into this unit because it repairs the new conversion path. Digital fixtures cover256gray levels, RGB/RGBA8/16, associatedU8/U16/F32, padded rows and malformed data; optical/external monitor scope open. Extract vendor-independent current Glycin port/tests; omit Cargo overrides, Debian metadata and vendored checksums.

new_items.title: Read BYTE and UNDEFINED metadata under the actual byte budget
new_items.notes: Actual code belongs to tiff0.11.3 at image-rs/image-tiff, carried inside Ubuntu glycin-loaders2.2.1. Read byte fields without allocating per-element Value objects; bound total metadata and grow only after successful reads.21,012-byte ICC fixture at80/320/1024pixels with BYTE/UNDEFINED and bad offset/excess count controls passes ordinary sandbox loader. Extract current TIFF crate change with crate-local regression; omit distribution overrides and checksum churn.

new_items.title: Honor an explicit SDR destination when grading clear Dolby video into ordinary GTK browser pages
new_items.notes: Public baseline WebKitGTK2.52.6 controls show identical output with/without Dolby carrier metadata. Active implementation is private, not a public patch kit. November9 handoff reports guarded full build resumed after memory stop; native SDR adapter evidence is not finished browser product acceptance. Keep discussion scoped to clear/unprotected SDR page output. Full high-precision HDR page composition, per-view typed target lifecycle, protected services and final browser comparison remain open. Do not publish private source/header or inference equations.

new_items.title: Validate and omit unavailable optional Wayland HDR metadata
new_items.notes: Separate producer from MPV-1: Vulkan WSI emitted MaxFALL=0, rejected by Weston. Source adds finite/quantized unsigned luminance bounds and optional-request omission. Corrected driver accepted. Extract from Debian quilt/changelog, port to current Mesa, add source regressions before submission.

new_items.title: Keep Wayland FIFO deadlines in the compositor clock domain
new_items.notes: About 4.1 seconds of false deadlines from CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW versus swapchain clock. Separate internal deadline and public completion domains; retain zero-time sentinel. Native timing controls and amd64/i386 packages qualified; player output drops retained. Needs current upstream port/test/description.

new_items.title: Authoritative frame-owned Dolby metadata and a bounded public RPU resolver
new_items.notes: New public resolver/strictness API: authoritative SPS rectangle, invalid-RPU withholding, bounded/reserved config rejection, reset metadata on live config change without resetting normal HEVC references. Native reorder/gap/flush/lifetime/conformance/config and pixel controls exist. Discuss upstream parser/side-data API, isolate local symbol/runtime plumbing. Follow-up config checks repair the proposed resolver, not independent preexisting upstream bugs.

new_items.title: Explicit display-target mapping hook and export metadata replacement
new_items.notes: Public adapter selects physical xy/luminance before generic conversion, replaces obsolete source Dolby/HDR10+ side data with destination metadata and keeps named fallback. Export/trim/crop and native chart controls exist. Current implementation depends on private provider and private renderer namespace: discuss/extract generic contract; private mapper equations and SDK implementation remain excluded.

new_items.title: Preserve raw RPU ownership when inheriting matched enhancement-layer metadata
new_items.notes: f_enhancement_pair refs raw RPU from matched EL onto BL, removes stale BL RPU and handles allocation failure. Distinct from October MPV-2 split fallback. Split this hunk from private provider/Wayland/build glue and add focused current-upstream pairing/lifetime regression. Staged 4K FEL and flip/failure controls are downstream evidence.

new_items.title: Separate physical targets from PQ transport and retain mapped cached-capture state
new_items.notes: Physical min/max/xy and reference-white transport are separate; paused/cache window captures preserve displayed grade and invalidate state on source/target change. Tagged PNG tests changed only authored edited frames; ordinary HDR10/native-source controls byte-equal. Generic target/capture lifecycle proposal requires agreement and extraction from optional private provider integration. No optical claim.

new_items.title: Frame-owned display-mapping hook before ordinary scaling and conversion
new_items.notes: Public renderer callback receives authoritative frame metadata and reconstructed native master; propagates mapper failure before generic conversion. Discuss generic hook/lifetime design and exclude private ABI namespace/build glue. LP-DM private equation work remains excluded; no private provider implementation is proposed.

new_items.title: Honor flipped enhancement planes and contributing-frame failure/target ownership
new_items.notes: Source honors vertical flip, rejects failed contributing-frame acquisition and avoids double release of borrowed mixer target. Native flip: three composed/mapped frames; failing non-reference acquisition correctly fails rendering. Extract upstream-generic fixes from the new hook fatal-state behavior; add current-upstream regression.

new_items.title: Picture-owned original RPU metadata across reordering and flushes
new_items.notes: New GstVideo meta owns AU bytes and uses matched GstVideoCodecFrame rather than last-picture state; only identity-compatible copies retain it. Native avdec/VA gap/reorder/seek/lifetime/transform controls exist. New meta/tag/copy API needs upstream agreement. Transport is not resolved metadata or FEL reconstruction.

new_items.title: Attach original HEVC RPU only from completed access units
new_items.notes: h265parse owns completed-AU bytes with parser/reset/flush safety; scoped positive/negative transport controls exist. Depends on proposed GstVideo meta API; requires upstream source port and native test harness.

new_items.title: Bounded reusable HEVC Dolby configuration parser in pbutils
new_items.notes: Reusable dvcC/dvvC parser validates version/flags/profiles/length and writes output only on success; missing compatibility does not infer color space. New public API needs upstream agreement; exclude distro ABI metapackage/symbol packaging.

new_items.title: Preserve authoritative Dolby configuration per MP4 sample entry
new_items.notes: qtdemux retains bounded sample-entry configuration with correct stream/caps transition and shared validation. Native no-config/replacement controls exist. Depends on pbutils API; compare current upstream and extract source-only patch from packaging.

new_items.title: Preserve bounded track-local Dolby configuration in Matroska
new_items.notes: Validates bounded BlockAdditionMapping payload/type, duplicates/conflicts and independent track state. 25 focused controls pass; stock negative rejects expected config; native P5 resolved 3 pictures. P7 check is config-only with no residual/reconstruction claim. Prepare current upstream patch/test/description.

new_items.title: Bind software libav decoder Dolby state to each decoded picture
new_items.notes: avdec consumes authoritative strict frame metadata, conformance geometry and live config transitions without resetting ordinary video; transforms discard stale provenance. Native mid-GOP/reset/equal-pixel controls pass. Current gstdovipicture helper and FFmpeg resolver are local: agree upstream owned snapshot API/dependencies first.

new_items.title: Associate native VA Dolby state with the decode-order surface
new_items.notes: Owned resolved snapshot follows VA surface through reordering, flush/config generations and visible crop. Native gap/reorder/seek/lifetime/conformance and transform controls exist. Depends on proposed public snapshot/resolver API; does not itself establish mapped FEL output.

new_items.title: Keep picture-owned Dolby provenance and conformance geometry in NVDEC
new_items.notes: Nine producer controls cover avdec/VA/NV; 95-picture config transitions retain normalized pixels; ordinary HEVC gains no Dolby metadata; transformations drop stale provenance. Depends on upstream snapshot/resolver design. Strip dependency/quilt wrappers. Native GStreamer P7 FEL reconstruction remains unfinished separately.

new_items.title: Preserve high precision through GL balance and invalidate changed color provenance
new_items.notes: glcolorbalance accepts RGBA64_LE; neutral passthrough retains input, transformed pixels discard color-sensitive provenance. Saved patch mixes full Debian quilt export/autogenerated placeholder metadata with 11 source lines: extract generic source fix and add upstream precision/meta tests.

new_items.title: Imported dovi_split, split-NAL length validation and HEVC EL configuration
new_items.notes: These are explicit upstream backports, not novel patches to send. Preserve original Kacper Michajlow and Michael Niedermayer attribution/signoffs. Packet identity is adapted from upstream 5f6dff5e7dbd9b1f3221f7c37225365dbf1e1038. Local version/build glue is excluded.

new_items.title: Imported C-FFI ownership, recoverable parser errors and pivot bounds
new_items.notes: Patch bodies explicitly backport upstream commits 4e6b263c35f08bca9efe919effac9c09c26fba70, 73daa31a8ecc76a4eedff8cb8f6197a3d66c3b3c and f41b2809cd00f41118248fcd8a1a3dff6216efcf. Preserve Nomis101/quietvoid authors. CRC-valid unsupported RPU aborts stock but patched parser returns error and accepts subsequent valid input. Do not resubmit or conflate with DV-5 mixed mapping.

new_items.title: Read-only selected-piece verification over caller-owned storage
new_items.notes: New public verify_selected_piece_ranges API reuses rqbit piece verification against callback-backed read-only storage, merges selected piece ranges, verifies neighboring boundary bytes and supports cancellation checkpoints. Existing source regression covers neighboring-file boundary bytes, corrupt payload and Interrupted callback. Discuss API shape first; export standalone current-upstream port and move tests into upstream before preparing a PR. Downstream stable delta alone is not an upstream kit.

new_items.title: Locate the first intersecting file before verifying a piece
new_items.notes: The same maintained patch replaces a scan over every preceding torrent file with partition_point and skips directly to the first intersecting file. This generic FileOps optimization can be split from the new API. Needs current-upstream check, isolated export and dedicated boundary/zero-length-file/performance regression; inspected source test is not sufficient proof of lookup behavior or speed.

new_items.title: Close upgraded API streams when their Raft group terminates
new_items.notes: An upgraded API WebSocket can outlive the listener and keep returning stopped-leader errors to survivors. Watch the corresponding Raft group metrics and stop the existing writer loop on shutdown, fatal running_state or a closed watch channel. Focused source test covers live updates and all three terminal cases; Makefile names it. Split the generic library fix from Runner minority-shutdown adapter changes, reconcile with current upstream socket lifecycle and produce an independently qualified port before PR preparation.

new_items.title: Preserve planar 10-bit software upload precision and required enhancement-layer cleanup
new_items.notes: Owned high-aligned UNORM16 staging preserves low-aligned planar 10-bit software filtering for Dolby and limited BT.2020/PQ, including ordinary HDR10. Hardware/P010/integer paths retain their behavior; required enhancement mapping failures clean partially owned resources. Source controls cover code values, strides, eligibility and lifetimes. No new execution, generalized native-build or GPU-performance claim. Extract the generic upload/cleanup change from private consumer glue and qualify against current mpv before submission.

new_items.title: Discuss reusable exact binary32-to-UNORM16 ties-to-even quantization
new_items.notes: Public integer GLSL helper rounds the exact binary32 input times65535 with ties-to-even rather than rounding a prior float product. Its actual consumer is the custom Vulkan mapped UNORM16 cache, not a generic stock libplacebo correction. Test source compiles the extracted shader as a CPU control against an independent rational oracle; expected exhaustive totals are assertions, not newly run results. Discuss the reusable quantizer API/placement and add native GPU validation; private mapping equations remain excluded.
